scope: Three actual native FightEngine renders under final wave28 code, including the 72 MiB combat cache change; static-stage composition review only

observations: The empty stone lane is continuous under both fighters; the red basin and cropped metal ring mechanism remain behind the footing.
The rear painted stela motifs remain distinguishable as static wall/monument art, not extra combatants; no source actor is baked into the plate.
Gray fighter silhouettes and large weapons remain legible against the muted burgundy and stone. The dome/oculus is partially covered by the existing HUD, without concealing combat.
Side camera, stela repetition, dome dimensions and device placement remain authored and unverified.
The rusted metal floor and grid shadows remain visible beneath both fighters; the horizontal lane contains no foreground obstruction.
Rear rails and diagonal braces sit behind the actors. Dark upper wall supports source-room atmosphere while actor edges and weapons remain readable.
The sparse rusted side posts do not enter the central combat region; there are no dolls, hanging organic sacks or unproven ceiling cables.
The camera, repeated rail spacing, grate dimensions and light pattern remain interpreted from native 320×180 reference cells.
The normal gray phase remains visible: pale fog, square slabs, concrete curb and chain-link bays with angled upper panels.
Both actors and their feet remain clearly readable against the neutral gray floor. Extreme-edge post fragments do not cover the play area.
No orange boss lighting, actors from the original game, rooftop collapse or foreground fall opening is baked into the art.
The intact horizontal fighting span, facade and regularized fence spacing remain authored adaptations rather than a measured reconstruction.

limits: Native Canvas does not exercise Chromium, DOM/CSS, HTTP, actual browser keyboard delivery or service workers.
No new fighter pose, attack, contact, guard, finisher, stage hazard, original timing or 1:1 artistic fidelity is certified.
Two static stage planes and their runtime parallax do not constitute a new source animation.
The small source images do not establish exact 1:1 camera geometry or texture reproduction. Visual review confirms usable composition and selected scene motifs only.
